title: Environment revision v1
description: The body of POST /v1/projects/{p}/environments/{e}/revisions (05.1.2-T1, 00 §9.3): the secret-free configuration of one target environment — base URLs and the dependency versions that affect results — plus secret references (never values). The server hashes base_urls, dependency_versions and the sorted secret_refs into revision_hash (sha256 over RFC 8785). Secret detection in values is the server's semantic check (reason secret_value_detected), not this schema's: a schema rule would not catch a token-shaped value either. The transport cap is 64 KiB.

name.description: Display name; used when the call creates the environment, and renames it otherwise; null is the same as absent

revision_no.description: Optional optimistic check: the number the caller expects this revision to get; any other next number is 409 revision_conflict; null is the same as absent

secret_refs.description: References of the form secret:<name>; anything else is refused as a secret value (secret_value_detected) without being echoed
